caption: The drawing depicts a segmented, wooden object composed of four distinct brown pieces arranged to suggest the form of an animal, specifically a quadruped with a long tail and a pointed snout. Each segment is rendered with textured shading to mimic the grain of wood, and they are joined together in a line, with two of the segments forming the legs. The head piece includes a lighter circular patch on the snout, a darker ear-like feature, and a faint diagonal reddish band across the neck area. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there is a faint handwritten signature in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Dachshund
